column1: # Ghidra extensions for the re-lab role, installed per user by re-lab-tools into
# release it was built for (major.minor), download URL, sha256 (the digest GitHub publishes).
# Each name needs a register row. The second column is the extension's own `version=`: a
# build for 12.1 on Ghidra 12.1.2 may make Ghidra ask (or refuse) at start — use the
# exact-version build when upstream has one. The Xbox loader (ghidra-xbe) states no licence.
